notes.title: Update 0.0.2 | Developer Update | May 2024
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first developer update of Spark Of Nature, thank you so much for the warm welcome of the early access, and get ready to see how the game grows along with the community! Here are what's new in the first update for the game:

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added emote [b]animations[/b] in the [b]Main Menu[/b]
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brand new typography
[*] New Launcher
[*] Updated Main Menu
[*] Updated Pause Menu
[*] Now the final wall [b]glows[/b] after each [i]aloe orb[/i] in [b][i]The Cabin[/i][/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed spelling mistakes for spanish
[/list]

[h3]Environment/Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more props to the living room in [b]The Cabin[/b].
[*] Updated visuals for [b]The Cabin[/b].
[*] Changed the layout for the skin selection in [b]The Lobby[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]

[h3]Unknown Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are aware of an issue that the buttons in the level 1 sometimes doesnt work as intended.
[/list]

Thank you so much for trying the early access of [b]Spark Of Nature[/b] and let us know what would you like to see in the game!

Take Care,

Team of [b]RebornPlanetStudios[/b].
